caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile design composed of two identical square panels side by side, each bordered by a wider, red outer frame and set within a cream or beige background. Inside each square panel, there are four stylized red star-shaped flowers positioned at the corners, with beige geometric shapes filling the spaces between the flowers. A branching beige stem with several leaves extends diagonally across the inner area of each square, forming the central motif. The border of each square is quilted with diagonal lines creating a diamond pattern, and thin, red lines intersect at the border corners. The colors used are predominantly shades of cream or beige for the background, beige for the central floral stems and leaves, and red for the flowers and border accents. The composition is symmetrical and evenly spaced, with both panels identical in design. The surrounding background of the drawing is plain and unadorned.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
